concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a finished high fidelity desktop website screenshot for ELEVATE contemporary architecture. Wide 16:10 landscape 1600x1000. ONE flat full-bleed website screenshot, not a mockup on a device. Distinct design direction: DARK CINEMATIC ARCHITECTURE with severe modernist art direction. A narrow charcoal vertical navigation rail on the far left with vertically arranged small menu labels and ELEVATE set vertically. To its right a huge cinematic full bleed photo of a dramatic concrete and glass modern building at blue hour with warm interior lighting, approximately 75 percent of the canvas. At the bottom a charcoal editorial project-information strip with a fine horizontal rule, a huge condensed sans-serif project title, and small index/city information. Add a very narrow right project selector with two vertically stacked tiny architecture images. Palette near-black, slate blue, warm amber interior light, off-white typography. Large condensed uppercase sans-serif title "BUILT TO ENDURE." Small text "Selected architecture", project "The Horizon House", navigation "Projects", "Studio", "Contact". Layout asymmetry, striking dramatic photographic impact, refined restrained minimal controls. NO ivory skincare styling, NO rounded bento cards, NO serif headline, NO standard top navigation and split hero. Realistic photographic imagery, crisp intentional website type, no watermark, no browser chrome.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a finished high fidelity desktop e-commerce homepage screenshot for TERRA skincare. Wide 16:10 landscape 1600x1000. ONE flat full bleed website screenshot. Distinct design direction: PLAYFUL CONTEMPORARY BEAUTY, fresh pastel lilac and butter yellow, large friendly rounded sans-serif typography, oversized soft shapes and joyful product art direction. Top thin lilac announcement bar "A little care goes a long way." Below on ivory a small lowercase brand "terra" at left and shopping nav "Shop", "The routine", "Our story", small bag icon. Main hero is a bright lavender split composition: left generous typographic message "Good skin. Good mood." in giant chunky rounded dark plum letters over three short lines; yellow pill CTA "Meet your routine". Right playful photorealistic product still life of lavender and pale yellow skincare packaging on rounded stepped plinths, with an elegant hand holding a cream tube, soft lavender studio lighting. A round butter-yellow stamp saying "Everyday essentials" overlapping the hero bottom edge. Bottom section ivory with horizontal product shelf: three clear skincare product thumbnails each with a product name, small price, and compact add-to-bag button. Main photo image height 65 percent page, supporting product shelf along bottom. Energetic experimental e-commerce. No warm stone botanical bento grid, no luxury serif typography, no monochrome fashion aesthetic. Clean sharp polished UI, authentic product photography, legible text, no browser frame, no watermark.

NOT beige luxury interiors, NOT warm serif headline, NOT linen-room hero, NOT rounded bento cards. Authentic premium furniture photography with blue chair as main focal point. Crisp detailed website UI, no watermark, no browser chrome.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a finished high fidelity desktop boutique resort homepage screenshot for AURA. Wide 16:10 landscape 1600x1000. ONE flat full bleed website screenshot. Distinct design direction: IMMERSIVE OCEAN TRAVEL with a breathtaking full screen aerial photographic view of a tiny lush tropical island in deep blue and turquoise water and a wooden overwater villa jetty. Ocean photo fills entire background, no cream canvas, no bento tile grid. At top very light minimal transparent navigation over the ocean: a fine white outline abstract sun emblem and spaced brand "AURA", centered text "The island", "Your stay", "Experiences"; top right small thin white outline CTA "Plan your escape". Main headline in very large airy elegant italic serif WHITE typography centered left over darker navy ocean: "Somewhere\nbeyond ordinary." Keep photoreal tropical island to the right, readable negative space at left. Small white subtitle "An island. A feeling. A world of your own." Discrete vertical scroll/coordinate detail left bottom. Most distinctive UI pattern: a FLOATING DARK NAVY BOOKING BAR across lower center with four segmented fields, tiny labels "Arrival", "Departure", "Guests", and pale turquoise rectangular "Find your stay" CTA. A small image thumbnail card of an overwater suite at lower right above bar with caption "Wake up to the ocean". Serene editorial luxury but deep blue high-impact full-screen visual, understated professional resort booking interface. NOT Mediterranean cream and stone, NOT warm bento panels, NOT standard split hero. Crisp type, original photographic realism, no monitor border, no browser frame, no watermark.
